newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Oil adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Oil adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Snyder Oil Corp said Wednesday that its board had authorized the adoption of a stockholder rights plan.
It said the rights will be issued June 3 to stockholders of record on that date and will expire on May 21, 2007.
"The stockholder rights plan is not being adopted at this time in response to any pending takeover threat," the company said in a statement.
It said the rights are exercisable if someone acquires 20 percent or more of the company's outstanding voting stock or announces a tender or exchange offer for ownership of such an amount.
Under such circumstances, right holders will be able to buy for $70 shares of the company's common stock having a market value of twice that amount.
It said each right entitles holders to buy one one-thousandth of a share of a new series of junior participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $70 per right.
The plan also includes an exchange option that allows the board to exchange the rights in whole or in part for shares of company stock, Snyder said.
